During Magh Mela, people take a holy dip in the sacred rivers to purify their souls and seek blessings from the gods.
data.spiritual_significance: Magha is considered a sacred and powerful name in Hinduism. It is believed that the name Magha confers blessings of good fortune, prosperity, and spiritual growth. Therefore, a Hindu girl named Magha is believed to possess inner strength, intelligence, and illumination.
